### 1. Architecture Overview
Updating `labels.Selector.Matches` to take a `context.Context` parameter will ripple through any code that evaluates Kubernetes label selectors at runtime. In Helm, selector-based filtering is used within the `helm list` action layer to pare down release objects before presenting them to CLI callers. The filtering pipeline resolves a user-supplied selector, converts each release’s stored labels into a `labels.Set`, and invokes `selector.Matches(...)` to decide whether to keep or discard that release. When the selector signature changes, the call site in this pipeline must be updated to supply an appropriate context (likely the parent request context) so that label evaluation remains functional.

### 2. Detailed Analysis
| Component | Details & Required Change |
|-----------|--------------------------|
| **Helm – action layer (`pkg/action/list.go`)** | The `List` action builds a sequence of filters; the selector filter is implemented by `filterSelector`. Inside the loop it currently calls `selector.Matches(labels.Set(rls.Labels))` to decide whether each `release.Release` should be returned. See lines 289‑296 where this invocation occurs: `if selector.Matches(labels.Set(rls.Labels)) { ... }`. Once `Matches` requires a context, this helper must be updated to pass one (probably threading through the `context.Context` already used elsewhere in list operations or creating one specific to the filter stage). Failure to adjust this call would break `helm list --selector ...`. *(Source: `helm/pkg/action/list.go`, lines 289‑296)* |

> **Gaps / Follow-Up Needed:** Due to the tool-call limit, I was unable to inspect Argo CD, external-dns, and ingress-nginx for additional call sites. Those repositories likely contain controller logic, list/watch utilities, and CLI features that also invoke `labels.Selector.Matches`. A follow-up search should enumerate every such call so their contexts can be threaded through as well.

### 3. Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| helm | `pkg/action/list.go` | `List.filterSelector` iterates releases and evaluates `selector.Matches(labels.Set(rls.Labels))`; this call must be updated to pass a `context.Context` once the interface changes. |

*No other files could be confirmed within the allotted analysis window; further repository scanning is required to identify Matches() usages in Argo CD, external-dns, and ingress-nginx.*
